load_pretrained_jasco_model: load a pretrained JASCO model using JASCO.get_pretrained with a model name like facebook/jasco-chords-drums-400M
generate_music_with_chords_and_drums: generate music conditioned on text descriptions, chord progressions, and drums waveform using JASCO.generate_music
generate_text_conditioned_audio: generate audio samples from text descriptions using JASCO.generate with optional progress tracking
set_jasco_generation_params: set classifier free guidance coefficients for JASCO generation using set_generation_params with cfg_coef_all and cfg_coef_txt
decode_audio_from_latents: decode generated audio latents into waveform using JASCO.generate_audio with unnormalized latent tensors
